verdict: WARNING — the official path is usable only from an exact committed disposable tree, with external receipt capture and a separate real-browser pass. No build, deploy, test, or file edit was performed.

release_target.live_alias_observation: Vercel CLI 59.4.0 resolved the alias to Ready production deployment dpl_fQUPEj7ou14yVxJzKccjZ7wvnsbm at inspection time. This is current provider state, not proof for the future revision.
release_target.linkage_model: No repository-local .vercel/project.json was found. scripts/deploy_vercel_dashboard.sh dynamically links its temporary staged site to the named project/scope immediately before deployment (lines 65-67), so the linkage is ephemeral and the project/scope arguments are the source of truth.

findings.title: Running the deploy script from the shared checkout would publish the dirty dashboard drafts
findings.failure_mode: The current worktree has all three served dashboard files modified. The script copies $WEB/dashboard/ directly with rsync and has no Git cleanliness or revision gate. Invoking it here would stage those unstaged bytes alongside the newly built game and publish them to production.
findings.existing_guards: The Godot project itself is copied to a temporary directory, but that does not protect the dashboard source tree. --dry-run also rebuilds game-track/web/public in the invoking checkout.
findings.minimal_correction: Run both dry-run and production only inside a git archive (or equivalent clean detached checkout) of the exact future commit. Never invoke either deploy mode in the current shared checkout.

findings.title: Staged hashes and deployment identity are emitted but not retained by the script
findings.failure_mode: The temporary site is deleted by the EXIT trap. Hash/size receipts are printed to stdout, vercel link output is suppressed, and the script does not persist a deployment ID or inspect result. If terminal output is lost, there is no durable binding from the staged bytes to the Vercel deployment.
findings.existing_guards: Prior release records manually retained deployment IDs and HTTP/hash receipts, but the script itself does not do so.
findings.minimal_correction: Pipe combined output through tee to an approved durable receipt directory, record the exact source commit, and immediately save `vercel inspect <production-alias> --scope akillness-projects --wait --timeout 180s` output. The deploy log is the authoritative staged-hash list; the inspect receipt supplies the dpl_* ID, status, generated URL, and aliases.

findings.title: No tracked executable helper proves the requested behavior in the deployed Godot binary
findings.failure_mode: The only `verify_dashboard_browser.cjs` file is untracked user work and deliberately intercepts `/public/index.html` with a fake HTML body. It validates synthetic dashboard rendering, not the downloaded Godot binary, Mira choices, Case File, or footer. The tracked native harness does validate four authored choices, scroll-to-view geometry, four Case File cards, and the close/footer instruction at 1400×900, 344×720, and 390×844, but it is native headless rather than post-deployment Web proof. The latest exact real-browser sequence exists only as a receipt, not a reusable script.
findings.minimal_correction: Use the focused tracked native test as the predeploy gate, then use a fresh browser session against the production `/public/` binary and repeat the recorded keyboard/gameplay sequence. Do not cite `verify_dashboard_browser.cjs` as deployed-binary evidence.

findings.title: The deploy path bundles existing PDFs; it does not build or freshness-check them
findings.failure_mode: A nonempty but stale `paper/latex/{en,ko}/main.pdf` passes preflight and is copied verbatim to `dist/paper/{en,ko}.pdf`. A manuscript source change without a rebuilt PDF would therefore publish stale papers.
findings.existing_guards: Both PDFs are regular tracked Git blobs, not Git LFS objects; their current index blob IDs are EN `04fdadaf01308e0c412d1011502f16e226b19b5e` and KO `6addfd50c0d7c7614d6cfc128b5a3ff48f4fc6d8`. The staging test proves both copied PDF digests appear in receipts, but does not establish source freshness.
findings.minimal_correction: The future release commit must already contain the reviewed rebuilt PDFs. Preserve their staged SHA-256 entries from the actual deploy log and verify `/paper/en.pdf` and `/paper/ko.pdf` byte-for-byte after deployment.

confirmed_safeguards.claim: Private rig and import-cache bytes are excluded.
confirmed_safeguards.evidence: `.gitignore:20-25` ignores every `assets/rig/*` byte except README and every nested `.godot/`; line 62 ignores generated Web output. `git ls-files` found only `game-track/godot/assets/rig/README.md` under those private/cache/output paths. `build_godot_web.sh:87-96` independently excludes `.godot/`, addons, tests, `_workspace`, research, local LLM scripts, and the entire `assets/rig/` directory from the staged Godot project.

confirmed_safeguards.claim: The canonical Godot project is not imported or rewritten.
confirmed_safeguards.evidence: `build_godot_web.sh:77-106` copies the project to `$STAGED_PROJECT`, changes `run/main_scene` only in that copy, and checks the copied config. Lines 111-115 pass `--path "$STAGED_PROJECT"` to both import and export. The canonical project is read/validated only.

confirmed_safeguards.claim: The production site shape is explicit.
confirmed_safeguards.evidence: `game-track/web/vercel.dashboard.json:2-16` sets outputDirectory `dist`, redirects `/` to `/dashboard/`, and redirects old `/index.html` to `/public/index.html`. The deploy script stages game under `dist/public`, dashboard under `dist/dashboard`, and papers under `dist/paper`.

confirmed_safeguards.claim: The Godot export is rebuilt for every deploy, including dry-run.
confirmed_safeguards.evidence: `deploy_vercel_dashboard.sh:34-41` always invokes `scripts/build_godot_web.sh`; stale ignored `game-track/web/public` bytes are not trusted.

notes: This packet is for the future approved committed revision. It is not to be run in the current shared checkout.

`deploy_vercel_dashboard.sh` itself invokes `build_godot_web.sh`; a separate production build command would duplicate work. The optional dry-run also performs a full build, but only inside the disposable archive below.
Set `RECEIPT_ROOT` to an approved durable location. Do not write into immutable raw sources, frozen experiment packets, or old receipts.
required_receipt_checks: `deploy-production.txt` contains one SHA-256/byte-count/path row for every staged file, including `./dist/paper/en.pdf` and `./dist/paper/ko.pdf`. These actual-production rows supersede optional dry-run hashes because production rebuilds.
`production-inspect.txt` contains the new `dpl_*` ID, `Ready`, generated deployment URL, and `https://sealed-lighthouse-trace-rpg.vercel.app` alias.

Postdeployment HTTP verification compares all staged paths to the deploy-log hashes, checks PDF MIME as `application/pdf`, WASM as `application/wasm`, and confirms `/vercel.json` is not public. There is no tracked reusable HTTP verifier; prior receipts such as `_workspace/current/qa/releases/2026-09-18/production-http-d074.json` show the expected result shape.

fresh_browser_verification.target: First inspect the alias to bind it to the new dpl_* ID, then open `https://sealed-lighthouse-trace-rpg.vercel.app/public/` in a fresh browser session. The production alias is public; prior records note the generated deployment URL may be protected.
fresh_browser_verification.predeploy_native_helper: `tests/test_godot_panel_lifecycle.py::test_contextual_ledger_dock_lifecycle_preserves_active_choices_and_overlays` runs `tests/godot_panel_lifecycle_harness.gd` on a disposable imported project. It checks four real authored Mira choices, each scrollable into the choice viewport, Case File four-card count, visible close/footer instruction, and panel containment at desktop and narrow sizes.
real_browser_sequence: Use 1440×1000 first; record console errors, page errors, failed requests, HTTP >=400 responses, and a screenshot at each material state.
BEGIN INVESTIGATION, complete/dismiss the tutorial, then START CASE.
Move the player to Captain Mira and press E.
Confirm the contextual dock opens with exactly four authored choices; scroll through all four and confirm the last choice is fully reachable, not clipped. Capture the open-choice state.
Press Escape; confirm the dock closes. Press E again; confirm dialogue reopens. Choose Step away; confirm the dock closes again.
Press C; confirm Case File opens, all four evidence cards exist, and the close/footer instruction is visible/reachable. Press C again; confirm it closes without resurrecting the dock.

Repeat the choice-scroll and Case File/footer visibility check at 390×844. Treat this as rendered engineering evidence only, not usability, immersion, affect, human benefit, generalization, or model efficacy.
Save a JSON receipt naming the bound dpl_* ID, URL, viewport(s), exact actions, error counts, screenshot hashes, and the engineering-only claim boundary.
fresh_browser_verification.do_not_use_for_this_claim: `scripts/verify_dashboard_browser.cjs` intercepts the game URL and runs synthetic renderer fixtures. It can supplement dashboard regression coverage only; it cannot replace fresh deployed-binary browser proof.

review_summary.verdict: WARNING — mitigate the two HIGH operational gaps with the disposable committed archive and durable receipt capture before any production release.
